The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1938–1939''' was contested by 51 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[AFC Ajax]] won this year's championship by beating [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[NEC Nijmegen|NEC]], [[FC Eindhoven]] and [[Achilles 1894]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Quick Nijmegen]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FVC (football club)|FVC]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[HVV 't Gooi]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[Hermes DVS]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]] and [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[AFC Ajax]], [[DFC (football club)|DFC]], [[RFC (football club)|RFC]], [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]], [[VUC (football club)|VUC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV DOS|DOS]]
